proposed_comments.title: Synchronize diagnostics lifecycle and concurrent cache publication
proposed_comments.body:
### Synchronize diagnostics lifecycle and concurrent cache publication

**Severity:** `high`

The current implementation can admit diagnostic mutations while `Stop()` is freezing the report, and concurrent cache/in-flight requests can observe a load before its diagnostic state is associated. That can produce reports with post-cutoff mutations, unstable demand/materialization attribution, or partially published load state. Please close mutation admission and synchronize Stop/report publication, publish cache/in-flight state atomically, keep retained diagnostics bounded, and add regression coverage for the race and lifecycle cases before merging.
